description: Before paying or trusting an address on Base, check what ChainWard's on-chain risk check says about it. Returns the neutral signal band and flag ids, plus the EAS attestation on Base (uid + explorer link) when ChainWard has published one, so the result is verifiable on-chain. Never a safety verdict: absence of flags is not a clearance. If the address has no report yet, say so and point to https://chainward.ai to run a free check.
name: check_counterparty
